t2.thesis: Abbott enters Q3 with strong Medical Devices momentum and reduced infant-formula litigation overhang following its August settlement, but soft Nutrition sales and a cautious 1-in-4 past earnings win rate temper the upside.
reasons: Core medical device franchise (Electrophysiology, Libre continuous glucose monitoring) and Exact Sciences integration delivered strong Q2 momentum and guidance raises.
August 2026 NEC formula litigation settlement of $670M cleared a massive catastrophic legal cloud that weighed heavily on 12-month share performance (-16.2%).
Valuation at 17.2x forward P/E is historically modest, though three out of the last four earnings releases resulted in negative open-to-open moves.
t2.deciding_variable: Q3 organic Medical Device sales growth (particularly Libre and Electrophysiology) and full-year EPS guidance reiteration or raise.

prior.from: Dossier base rates for BMO sessions (0.548 across 898 events) and overall validation rate (0.542)

t2.moved_from_prior: Moved down 2 percentage points from the 0.55 BMO prior to 0.53, balancing constructive device momentum and legal relief against the poor historical 4-quarter reaction track record (25% win rate) and ongoing pediatric nutrition volume declines.

theses.expected: Abbott beats Q3 EPS consensus of $1.41 and nudges the full-year adjusted EPS floor toward the upper half of its $5.45-$5.60 range, driving an opening gain.
theses.mechanism: Double-digit organic growth in Diabetes Care and Electrophysiology offsets lingering weakness in Nutrition and legacy diagnostics.
theses.wrong_if: Pediatric nutrition margins contract further or Exact Sciences integration costs suppress operating margins below consensus.

theses.expected: Guidance is merely reaffirmed at current midpoint with no upward revision, causing the stock to open flat to slightly negative.
theses.mechanism: Conservative management guidance heading into Q4 leaves short-term momentum traders disappointed after a recent +3.1% 5-day run-up.
theses.wrong_if: Strong cash generation and positive pipeline catalysts (such as Libre Duo or IVL pivotal updates) trigger institutional re-rating.

theses.expected: Unexpected legal accruals or foreign exchange drag erode earnings quality, causing an opening decline.
theses.mechanism: Remaining NEC claims (approx. 12,700 infant cases) force additional unexpected reserve build.
theses.wrong_if: The August settlement has established an acceptable liability ceiling in the eyes of institutional investors.

key_observations: Adjusted diluted EPS vs consensus estimate of $1.41 (guidance was $1.38-$1.46)
Diabetes Care / FreeStyle Libre sales growth rate (was +11.0% reported in Q2)
Worldwide Nutrition segment sales and whether volume declines in pediatric formulas show stabilization
Updates on remaining NEC preterm infant formula litigation exposure
t2.method: D004 v4: leak-probe call without the dossier, then one decision call on the frozen dossier; no tools
